summary: Frontend-only testing of UNO Game, Family Feud, and Match page game mode transitions. All UI components render correctly. Code review verified proper implementation of UNO layout, socket handlers, and Family Feud mobile keyboard handling.
critical_code_review_comments: UnoGame.jsx: Properly implements data-testid attributes for all interactive elements (uno-game, uno-close, start-uno-btn, uno-draw-pile, uno-call-btn, uno-card-*, uno-color-*)
UnoGame.jsx: Layout correctly follows spec - opponent cards top, discard/draw pile center, player hand bottom
UnoGame.jsx: Mobile layout uses horizontal scroll for hand with proper touch scrolling (-webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch)
UnoGame.jsx: Color picker modal properly implemented for wild cards with data-testid for each color
UnoGame.jsx: Turn indicator shows correct player with visual distinction (green glow for active turn)
UnoGame.jsx: Playable cards have visual highlight (white border + glow) and hover effects
UnoGame.jsx: Draw pile is clickable when it's player's turn and no valid moves available (pulse animation)
UnoGame.jsx: UNO call button appears when player has 2 cards with urgent pulse animation when must call
UnoGame.jsx: Special card effects (skip, reverse, +2, +4) show notification toasts
FeudGame.jsx: Mobile keyboard handling implemented using visualViewport API
FeudGame.jsx: UI adapts when keyboard visible - score bar hidden, padding/fonts reduced, question stays visible
FeudGame.jsx: Input field fixed at bottom with safe-area-inset-bottom for iOS
Match.js: Game buttons (UNO, Feud, T/D) only appear in matched state, not during searching
Match.js: Game mode controls (Report/Skip) visible during active game with proper z-index
Match.js: Mini video panels appear during game mode with proper positioning
match.css: .video-panel--mini styles correctly size mini video previews during games

test_credentials.note: No premium users in database. UNO requires two matched premium users for full multiplayer testing.

seed_data_creation: None - used guest login for UI verification
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend UI components verified via code review and Playwright automation. UNO game requires two matched premium users to test full multiplayer flow - cannot be tested with single user. All socket event handlers are properly wired in UnoGame.jsx (uno_game_started, uno_card_played, uno_card_drawn, uno_called, uno_game_ended, uno_error). Family Feud mobile keyboard handling uses visualViewport API correctly.
